descriptionText: Role Title: Mechanical Design Engineer — Robotics CNC Parts (Remote) Role Type: Contractor Location: Fully remote ### Opportunity Snapshot Pay: $90 -$155/hour Duration: Initial phase of 20 part packages; production phase to follow Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineer micro1 is engaging senior mechanical design engineers to create original CAD part packages for a client project in robotics. Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required. Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well. ### What you'll do - Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP. - Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard. - Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale. - Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate. - Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score. - Revise your own packages against review findings. ### What we're looking for - 5+ years of production engineering experience with comparable CNC parts, materials and processes in robotics. - Technical decision authority: you owned or approved critical design choices — drawing, tolerance or material approval, production release, or enforcing engineering quality standards. Design leads, principal and staff engineers, and technical authorities are the profile. - Experience at OEMs or specialist suppliers whose engineering standards you can reproduce. - Strong GD&T and tolerancing judgment, including cost and inspection implications. - Access to parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo or similar) and the ability to deliver native files plus STEP. - Industry experience, not academic. ### Important: originality and IP Every design must be your own original work. You cannot use designs owned by a current or former employer or customer, and you cannot substitute public or purchased CAD. All deliverables become the client's property. If you're currently employed, check your employment agreement regarding outside work and invention assignment before applying. ### How the selection process works - Apply and complete the screening questions - Complete the AI interview for this role — it's how your expertise gets in front of the client - Profile review, including evidence of comparable parts and decisions owned - Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up
